positions.pos: The way from playing into making is a hatch on the living ship: a crew member carrying a glowing crate steps down through it, and following them is the choice. No menu asks a newcomer whether they want to learn game development.
positions.why: From your Kodree note, 2026-10-24: "I'd like them to play the game and eventually decide they want to do game development and they play the game to learn more about how to make the game." Every strong reference (Dreams, Mario Maker) keeps the hand on the same world; a menu is the separate-app seam they warn against. Concept page: https://claude.ai/artifact/KjBp8CUMPrA3AQwRjf47MG

positions.pos: A newcomer's first act of making is tuning something they already used in Chapter 1 (the lantern), never a blank page.
positions.why: Remix before blank page is the common move in Scratch, PICO-8 and Mario Maker. Concept page: https://claude.ai/artifact/KjBp8CUMPrA3AQwRjf47MG

positions.pos: The onboarding ladder runs Passenger, Stowaway, Deckhand (unpaid play on practice copies), then Crew, Officer, Shipwright, which are the artist corps Contractor, Associate and Member tiers. The first real crate of work is the Contractor tier and is paid.
positions.why: pos-ac-coop-pipeline sets the three tiers and pos-ac-paid-hours says every working hour is paid, so play stays play until real work starts. Concept page: https://claude.ai/artifact/KjBp8CUMPrA3AQwRjf47MG

positions.pos: The hatch, the cabins and the commissions all work with human crew and no model; AI crew are opt-in.
positions.why: The Portland community's allergy to AI (bars-engine CLAUDE.md) and q-ac-ai-boundary C. Concept page: https://claude.ai/artifact/KjBp8CUMPrA3AQwRjf47MG

positions.pos: Kodree is a feeling reference only: world and code on one screen, a quest that makes something. Its badges, XP bar and streak tiles are the flat look we replace with places in the ship.
positions.why: A look at kodree.com found a themed task list with no sample lesson shown and unsourced numbers. You said you could not prove it delivered. Concept page: https://claude.ai/artifact/KjBp8CUMPrA3AQwRjf47MG

questions.q: Does following a crew member down through a hatch feel like the right way for a newcomer to find game development?
questions.why_you: Only your look can say whether the seam lands, and code waits on your yes (art first). The two stills are below; the page has the first 60 seconds, the reference board and the ladder: https://claude.ai/artifact/KjBp8CUMPrA3AQwRjf47MG
questions.not_before: Raised by the play-to-make concept pass, 2026-10-24.
